scripts.cp-mac: cargo build --release && rm -rfv builds/* && node scripts/cp-version.js && scp builds/* rsync-user@calcit-lang.org:/web-assets/repo/calcit-lang/binaries/macos/
scripts.check-literal-paths: cargo run --bin calcit -- calcit/bench-literal-paths.cirru && cargo run --bin calcit -- --emit-path target/literal-path-js calcit/bench-literal-paths.cirru js && node scripts/bench-literal-paths.mjs
scripts.check-typed-method-rem: cargo run --bin calcit -- calcit/fibo.cirru && cargo run --bin calcit -- --emit-path target/typed-method-rem-js calcit/fibo.cirru js && node scripts/bench-typed-method-rem.mjs
scripts.bench-recur-smoke: cargo run --bin calcit -- calcit/test.cirru js && node --input-type=module -e "import { test_loop } from './js-out/test-recursion.main.mjs'; const n=3000; const t0=process.hrtime.bigint(); for(let i=0;i<n;i++) test_loop(); const dt=Number(process.hrtime.bigint()-t0)/1e6; console.log('test_loop_ms='+dt.toFixed(3));"
scripts.bench-enum-match: cargo run --release --example bench_enum_match && yarn compile && node scripts/bench-enum-match.mjs
scripts.bench-literal-paths: cargo build --release --bin calcit && yarn compile && target/release/calcit calcit/bench-literal-paths.cirru && node scripts/bench-literal-paths-native.mjs && target/release/calcit --emit-path target/literal-path-js calcit/bench-literal-paths.cirru js && node scripts/bench-literal-paths.mjs
scripts.bench-typed-method-rem: cargo build --release --bin calcit && yarn compile && target/release/calcit calcit/fibo.cirru && node scripts/bench-typed-method-rem-native.mjs && target/release/calcit --emit-path target/typed-method-rem-js calcit/fibo.cirru js && node scripts/bench-typed-method-rem.mjs
scripts.check-smooth: yarn fmt-rs && yarn lint-rs && yarn test-rs && yarn check-all
scripts.check-all: yarn compile && yarn test-calx-bench-settings && yarn check-js-runtime && yarn check-agent-interface && yarn try-core-tests && yarn try-rs && yarn try-js && yarn try-ir && yarn try-wasm && yarn check-literal-paths && yarn check-typed-method-rem
scripts.try-core-tests: cargo run --bin calcit -- src/cirru/calcit-core.cirru test --tag unit --summary-only
scripts.try-js-brk: cargo run --bin calcit -- calcit/test.cirru js && cp scripts/main.mjs js-out/main.mjs && node --inspect-brk js-out/main.mjs
scripts.try-js: cargo run --bin calcit -- calcit/test.cirru js && cp scripts/main.mjs js-out/main.mjs && node js-out/main.mjs
